summary.name: Particle Art (Digital and 3D Aesthetics; explicit provenance). Source gives no separate usage label.
summary.visualIdentity: Subjects form from particle density, size, brightness and color against a contrasting field. Trails may show direction. Particles hold stable silhouettes at key moments, and glow is constrained so detail stays visible.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to abstract brand moments and transformations between silhouettes. Inferred from source combinations: data stories where particles map to real quantities, and openers where particles resolve into real type. An optional fireworks or light-particle recipe is included.
summary.limitations: Glow must never erase silhouette detail, and bloom stays bounded. Avoid long sentences rendered as particles, continuous jitter during reading holds, and full-screen glow used to hide weak choreography. Final legible text must be real type. Simulated motion is not physical validation. Interactive HTML behavior is not defined beyond combination guidance.
summary.palette: Suggested only when no approved palette is supplied: #111C29 background, #EFF5EE foreground and highlights, #65BEC2 cool body accent, #CEAF79 warm focal accent. Gradients are disabled and four base colors are the limit. Contrast checks are two-color only: #EFF5EE on #111C29 is 15.521, #111C29 on #65BEC2 is 7.936, and on #CEAF79 is 8.21. Supplied exact colors override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Per-particle motion is evaluated analytically in the shader, with GSAP driving uniforms on a paused timeline so every seek is exact. The 3s preview runs drift 0–0.8s, flow into the silhouette 0.8–2.0s, then hold 2.0–3.0s. Fireworks use seeded births and p0+v·t+½g·t² trajectories with fading trails. Deliberate cuts and reading holds should be preserved.
summary.audio: The source specifies no audio, so audio is unspecified for this style. Choices should follow the topic, task requirements and any supplied audio. Music timing must not be assumed without inspecting actual audio. Inferred: silence or ambience may suit reading holds. Speech intelligibility and clean mixing must be verified.
summary.assetRequirements: The source requires no supplied image or video. Implementation needs seeded point samples from a sphere pose and a procedural silhouette such as a bird or logo shape. Approved glyph or mark geometry is needed only for motion references 037–039. Local fonts and assets must load before rendering. Whether task-provided assets exist is unspecified.
summary.combinations: Style-097 (data mapping) turns particles into quantity-based formations, with SVG axes and labels in #EFF5EE and bloom never covering labels. Style-093 (kinetic typography) has particles converge on glyph targets while real type holds the reading. Motion references 037–039 fit only when the scene contains a matching phrase, punctuation or mark. References 002, 004, 010, 012, 014 and 015 lack the review evidence attached to 037–039.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Three.js Points with BufferGeometry, GLSL ShaderMaterial and UnrealBloomPass for bounded glow. Motion engine: GLSL owns per-particle motion and GSAP owns the uniforms, so each property has one owner. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with the paused timeline registered in window.__timelines and checked, snapshotted and rendered. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists.
